name: feature-standards-auth
publicationMethod: Initial manual cargo publish --locked --registry crates-io from the immutable source commit after full main-branch CI passed. The owner authenticated locally; no token is recorded in this receipt or added to repository secrets.
scope: The public checksum, anonymous crate download, Cargo cache download and reviewed CI archive identify identical bytes.
The independent consumer uses exact registry version =0.1.0 and a new Cargo home without publisher credentials; no local path or patch dependency is used.
One in-process Axum integration test and all 19 common v1 tests against a real loopback consumer server passed; its own server process was stopped.
Browser, PostgreSQL, SMTP and OIDC trusted-publisher execution were not rerun or established by this initial manual release.
Existing cache-permission warnings from the publisher did not prevent verification or publication; no user-cache permissions were changed.
